label: Over a supplied clock: whatever is a first mover moved by none at some time t is moved in no…
paraphrase: Over a supplied clock: whatever is a first mover moved by none at some time t (it moves something at t and is moved in no respect at t) is moved in no respect at any time. This unattributed bridge is open; it fails in the strictly forward feedback model of FIRST-WAY-SLICE-CONTROLS.
